method: The 20 pairs are hol_measure.json handcheck_sample (seed 20261120: 10 US, 10 UK). Each pairs one dated row of the government list with the statute item whose rule yields that date. Checked by reading the statute item against the row's holiday and date: correct when the statute item is the legal basis of that observance (including in-lieu and substitute days).
